evals.prompt: Convert the PDF file to markdown
evals.expected_output: A markdown file with text extracted from the PDF
expectations: The output contains page-based structure with ## Page headers or similar section markers
Text content from the PDF is preserved in the markdown
The output mentions which engine was used for conversion

evals.prompt: Convert this DOCX file to markdown format
evals.expected_output: A markdown file with content extracted from the Word document
expectations: Headings from the DOCX are preserved as markdown headings
Lists in the DOCX are preserved in the markdown
The output file contains the converted content

evals.prompt: Convert this PPTX file to markdown
evals.expected_output: A markdown file with content extracted from the PowerPoint presentation
expectations: The output contains slide-based structure with ## Slide headers
Text content from the PPTX slides is preserved in the markdown
Tables from the PPTX are converted to markdown tables

evals.prompt: Convert the image file to markdown using OCR
evals.expected_output: A markdown file with text extracted from the image via OCR
expectations: Text is extracted from the image using OCR
The output mentions using pytesseract as the engine
